prompt: My director says this slide is confusing. Here's the script that generates it (bad_slide.py) and the current output (bad_slide.png). What's wrong with it? Fix it and give me the new PNG. It's for the quarterly business review with sales leadership; the point is that adding reps hasn't grown revenue.
assertions: Response names a single biggest problem first
3D/shadowed pie chart is replaced by a sorted bar chart or text
Secondary y-axis is removed (direct labels or separate panels sharing the x-axis)
Truncated revenue bar axis (starting at 4.0) is fixed or bars replaced by a line
Rainbow colors replaced by grey plus a single accent
New chart has an action title stating reps grew while revenue stayed flat
Numbers in titles/annotations match the source data (reps 38 to 55, revenue about 4.1 to 4.2M)
